'''Kelvarek Consolidated Arms''', also known as '''Kelvarek Industries''' during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], manufactured high yield miniature weapons systems like the the [[MM9 mini concussion rocket launcher/Legends|MM9 rocket system]] made famous by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango]] and [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], as well as the [[MM7 rocket-powered flechette launcher]] and the [[Dissuader KD-30]].
